purpose: Finite incremental unified server-call-pin comparison candidate/base; not official-version target evidence or release acceptance
topology: hosted ubuntu24.04; one process containing loopback TCP client and server; one worker; same two allowed logical CPUs selected on distinct guest-reported (socket,core)
affinity: smallest allowed online CPU, then smallest allowed online CPU on a different guest (socket,core); stop if mapping unavailable
isolationClaim: None; retain guest core/socket/SMT and cgroup observations; no physical-core isolation claim
quantile: nearest rank ceil(n*p), exact integer rational rank, no floating-point percentile rank
pairOrder: Odd pair baseline then candidate; even pair candidate then baseline; six pairs/cell (three ABBA blocks); four scenarios rotated modulo four by pair index
failurePolicy: retain every planned slot and all raw failures; no replacement, exclusion, retry, adaptive stop or claim from incomplete evidence
releaseBoundary: Incremental unified server-call-pin candidate afad64bf versus dd0dcacd baseline only. Four representative intercepted normal-completion stream cells. Ordinary no-CT paths are tracked, not legacy fallback. Previously observed adverse legacy-fallback mechanism result remains a known limitation; no fallback TCP controls added. Dynamic module-retirement correctness is required before TCP. GenerationControl and AOT are outside this campaign. No official NuGet 2.0.3 comparison, original target, full parity or release-acceptance claim.
interopBoundary: Both same-version3.0.0 endpoints and own Generator/API5; no endpoint or generated-assembly mixing.
aggregation: Per cell median of six paired candidate/baseline QPS and P99 ratios; additionally recorded process-wide (client + server + runtime) double CPU microseconds/operation and allocated bytes/operation paired absolute values, ratios and median ratios. CPU/allocation are descriptive, no new target thresholds; allocated bytes are not object counts; exact rational ratios represent the recorded decimal values, not independent raw CPU-tick or allocation-census reconstruction. No operation pooling, best round, cross-cell global pass or incomplete-input target observations.
coldPolicy: Eight strict-cleanup processes (both arms x four cells) and eight symmetric normal-validate processes must pass before timing. Each of 48 fresh normal-measure processes repeats normal-only controls. No cancellation/failure/early-exit probe in timed processes.
evidencePolicy: Raw ticks, reports, traces, build logs and all failures stay runner-local; no artifact upload, commit, comment, raw log dump or evidence publication. Independent same-job offline validator emits bounded per-cell QPS/P99 ratios, CPU/allocation paired absolute metrics and ratios, and failure status only. Ephemeral samples cannot support downstream independent recomputation.

dependencyPolicy.buildClosure: Four identical private10.0.12 dependency DLLs copied to both prepared snapshots; these are build closure, not asserted runtime load origins.
dependencyPolicy.executionClosure: Exactly four pinned Microsoft dependency identities from private Microsoft.AspNetCore.App10.0.14, common to both arms; all product and fixture assemblies remain own-arm only.
dependencyPolicy.remainingFrameworkClosure: Every other loaded non-dynamic assembly must match canonical path and SHA256 derived independently from the two fixed SHA512-verified private runtime14 archives; unknown, inserted or symlinked DLLs rejected. Collection and hashing occur outside all timing windows.

targetInterpretation: QPS1.10/P99.80 markers apply only to incremental candidate/baseline ratios; reaching them cannot establish the original goal versus officialNuGet2.0.3.

ordinaryUnitGate.requirement: Both arms execute their complete freshly discovered ordinary corpus exactly once under Core-only runtime14 before any TCP. Exact UID equality and zero skips/failures/cancellations/timeouts/flaky passes; no rebuild after shared-product freeze.
ordinaryUnitGate.scope: Only the existing five source-reviewed Explicit worker UIDs excluded. Ordinary TCP/UDS functional tests included.
ordinaryUnitGate.dynamicModuleRetirement: Both arms must freshly discover and execute the exact actual dynamic module-retirement integration UID, not module-configured mechanism substitution.
ordinaryUnitGate.runtimeDomain: Private Microsoft.NETCore.App 10.0.14 only, separately installed from dual-framework TCP host.
ordinaryUnitGate.record: Both TCP driver and validator require two-arm unit-gate.json with tool/source/tree, frozen-product hash equality, UID digest equality and actual runtime14 allocation-child and dynamic-retirement witnesses.

preparationPolicy: One aggregate graph build per arm for canonical unit/integration outputs; identical shared product bytes frozen once (nine-DLL closure: five product DLLs plus four support12 DLLs, and own Generator). No pack/rebuild. Fixtures compile with explicit frozen references and own Generator. Before any TCP, actual compiled/evaluated metadata, all snapshots and correctness records must match the single protocol source/tree identities. NuGetAudit=true/all and all warnings strict; fresh writable CLI/HTTP/scratch/XDG directories before first build.
